text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with 
Furioso...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Furioso was gazing, I saw a 
claw machine filled with plushies modeled 
after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Paka Petits... If you look closely, 
they're all Umamusume who shine in the 
Central League.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If I kept this in my room... I feel like 
I'd wake up feeling refreshed every 
morning.
choice_data_list: And the meaning behind that is...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it make your competitive spirit 
against Central throb? ...Because I don't 
want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was looking at Paka Petit plushies of 
Central Umamusume. As a Trainer, they are 
rivals that Furioso and I must defeat. 
...In that case—
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, let me take it!
As your Trainer, please let me take it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...And what is the meaning behind that?
choice_data_list: Guiding Furioso is my job, after all.
Guiding Furioso is my job, after all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. I will be waiting. Please 
don't lose to the Paka Puchi from the 
Central, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
